The '''Aquaculture Facility''' was an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] research facility located on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Uridia]]. It was established as part of the [[Ando Project]], and processed [[Uridium]] by submerging it in water inhabited by [[Andoan mineral-fish]]. The creatures fed off the raw rock, and the Uridium was then concentrated in the [[Fish/Legends|fish's]] tissue and was then extracted. A [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] team discovered the base during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="Ando">{{JournalCite|11|The Ando Project}}</ref>
